notes.title: Update v1.6: Mouse sensitivity & Unity Update
notes.notes:
StratoBash has been updated to Unity 5.6.5p4.

Also, a new launch parameter (also known as argument) has been added:

--sensitivity=<mouse sensitivity multiplier>

The default is:

--sensitivty=1.0

This would double the mouse sensitivity:

--sensitivity=2.0

Here are the instructions for setting launch options:

https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=1040-JWMT-2947

notes.title: StratoBash v1.5 Update
notes.notes:
StratoBash has been updated! SteamVR has been updated to the latest build, Unity engine updated (latest v5.6) & a new argument to invert the Y mouselook has been added. Add "--invertlook" (without quotes, note double dash) to the arguments to use Y mouselook inversion.

This update is now available for everyone.
